integrity: The proof is analytic. The included exact-arithmetic verifier checks the finite algebraic identities and selected sample sizes; the universal positivity step is proved symbolically and is not inferred from finite computation.
scientific_limitations: The theorem proves local non-optimality along the symmetric three-point mass path for every sample size at least three. It does not identify global maximizing mass vectors, treat non-extreme order pairs, or treat larger supports.
title: Sample size two is the exact boundary for three-point uniform-probability extremality
